headline: QA Automation Engineer | Playwright and TypeScript
summary: Highly motivated QA Automation Engineer with 2 years of experience in developing and implementing automated test suites. Proven ability to collaborate with developers and stakeholders to ensure high-quality software releases. Passionate about using cutting-edge technologies to improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.

bullets: Developed and maintained automated test suites using Playwright and TypeScript, resulting in a 20% reduction in manual testing time.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment, ensuring faster feedback loops and continuous delivery.
Created comprehensive test documentation and reports, providing insights into test coverage and potential issues.
Collaborated with developers to identify and resolve bugs, contributing to the release of high-quality software products.
